description: Werkingsgebied - Beschermingszone regionale waterkering is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.noord-holland.nl. This scope is part of the Environmental Regulation NH2020, adopted on 16-11-2020 (Decision No: 1477251/1478383). The plan can be consulted on spatialplans.nl via this link: more information about this scope can be found in article(s): 6.77. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Scope — Regional flood protection zone" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ruimtelijke ordening. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
